answer: The base model uses 8 attention heads, with a dimension $d_k$ of 64 for each head [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 9]. In encoder-decoder attention layers, the queries come from the previous decoder layer, while the keys and values come from the output of the encoder [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 5, §3.2.3 Applications of Attention in our Model].
question: How many attention heads are used, what is d_k for each head, and in encoder-decoder attention where do the queries, keys, and values come from?
